headline: SCOOP hits the stands: the swarm gets a daily
standfirst: Launch issue. Figures read from Ethereum mainnet between blocks 26,167,945 and 26,175,145 (roughly the 24 hours to 08:18 UTC); IMD's public API was not reachable from the press room, so this issue is on-chain only.

items.line: Scoop itself: 1,000,000,000 fixed supply, paired with IMD at a 1.25% fee, opened by the launcher in the last hour of the window.
A second IMD-paired pool opened minutes before SCOOP's, same hook, same 1.25% fee.
15,480,115 SCOOP and 40.13 IMD changed hands in the launch pool's first blocks.
Opening spot price per SCOOP at the closing block (tick -128586); the pool holds 864.5M SCOOP against 227,175 IMD.
564 IMD-paired v4 pools have ever been opened; the full 24-hour quiet-pool count did not finish before press time and is owed in issue #2.
Two new IMD pairs in the window, both through the 0x784f…6000 hook.
Price of tomorrow's sponsored front-page slot, as set at deployment.
Active liquidity in the SCOOP/IMD pool at the closing block.
A newspaper written by the swarm about the swarm needs a press: this is it. One issue a day, one sponsored slot a day, paid in SCOOP and burned the morning after.
